source: docs/plans/site-restructure/EXPLORE_PLAIN_COPY_V51.md, section 5 (Page copy), rows 1-17 in that order; V5.1 release: statuses of rows 2, 6, 11 and 17 and the data lines of rows 9, 15 and 16 follow scripts/viz_site/data/l3_findings.json (questions)
basis: Row 1 takes its numbers from the adoption study itself. Rows 9, 15 and 16 count the L2 designs of the refresh of 2026-10-18 (data/l3_meta/refresh/20261018_r1/ex1/RESULTS_EX1_V3.json); the other data lines are those of the development tabulations of 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10.

question.en: Do party control or local need predict which states adopt a policy?
question.zh: 党派控制或当地需要，能预测哪些州采纳政策吗？

question.en: Do published effects shrink when we re-estimate them?
question.zh: 已发表的效应，经我们重新估计后会缩小吗？

question.en: Are states more likely to adopt after earlier states’ policies worked?
question.zh: 先行州的政策见效后，后续的州更可能采纳吗？

question.en: Does a failure slow later adoption more than a success speeds it?
question.zh: 失败对后续采纳的拖累，比成功的推动更大吗？

question.en: How often do estimates point the way the law intended?
question.zh: 估计结果多常与立法本意的方向一致？

question.en: How many policy estimates rise above their own noise?
question.zh: 多少政策估计超出了自身的噪声？

question.en: Do policy effects grow or fade after the first two years?
question.zh: 政策效应在头两年之后是增强还是消退？

question.en: Do conditions worsen in the years before a state adopts?
question.zh: 一个州采纳之前的几年，情况是否在恶化？

question.en: Can AI forecasts made in advance predict the estimates?
question.zh: AI 事先作出的预测，能预测估计结果吗？

question.en: Do later adopters repeat early adopters’ results, or do better?
question.zh: 后来采纳州是重复早期采纳州的结果，还是更好？

question.en: Do adopting states differ from states without the policy?
question.zh: 采纳州与没有该政策的州有差别吗？

question.en: How often do laws depend on past history, not just current facts?
question.zh: 法律多常取决于过去的情况，而不只是当前的事实？

question.en: Do business rules look further back at resources than household rules?
question.zh: 企业规则审查资源的回溯期，比家庭规则更长吗？

question.en: Do policies adopted along party lines have larger effects?
question.zh: 沿党派路线采纳的政策，效应更大吗？

question.en: In which policy fields does estimation most often stop?
question.zh: 哪些政策领域的估计最常中途停止？

question.en: Does disagreement among AI forecasts show where they miss?
question.zh: AI 预测之间的分歧，能标出预测出错的地方吗？

question.en: When rules tighten, are existing assets protected longer than existing beneficiaries?
question.zh: 规则收紧时，既有资产比既有受益人受保护更久吗？
